title: Rice Blast (Dhaan ka Jhonka Rog)
description: Spindle-shaped lesions on leaves with grayish centers. Spreads rapidly in high humidity conditions. Reported in Kishanpur block farms.

metadata.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions on leaves with grayish centers. Spreading rapidly due to high humidity.
metadata.organicTreatment: Spray Neem oil formulation (3,000 ppm) at 3 ml per liter of water. Ensure proper spacing between rows.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP at 0.6 grams per liter of water. Avoid water logging.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Destroy previous crop residues. Do not apply excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
metadata.outbreakIndicator: 3 nearby farms in Kishanpur reported Rice Blast in the last 48 hours.

title: Cotton Leaf Curl (Kapas ka Patta Marod Rog)
description: Upward curling of leaf margins, thick veins on leaves, stunted plant growth in cotton crops.

metadata.symptoms: Upward curling of leaf margins, thick veins on leaves, stunted plant growth.
metadata.organicTreatment: Introduce ladybird beetles to control whiteflies vector. Spray garlic-chili extract.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.5 ml per liter of water to control vector.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Use resistant cotton hybrids. Eliminate weed hosts near field bunds.
metadata.outbreakIndicator: 1 farm in Laxmipur block reported leaf curl vector outbreak.

title: Early Blight (Ageti Jhulsa Rog)
description: Concentric dark brown circular spots appearing first on older leaves, forming a target board pattern.

metadata.symptoms: Concentric dark brown circular spots appearing first on older leaves, forming a target board pattern.
metadata.organicTreatment: Mulch soil surface with crop residue. Spray copper hydroxide or bio-pesticide Trichoderma.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2 grams per liter of water immediately.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Ensure crop rotation. Water roots directly instead of overhead leaf sprinkling.

title: Wheat Yellow Rust / Yellow Leaves (Gehun me Peeli Pattiyan / Peela Rog)
description: Yellowing of wheat leaves (peeli pattiyan) caused by Nitrogen deficiency, water logging, or Yellow Rust (Puccinia striiformis) fungal infection.

metadata.symptoms: Yellow stripes or complete yellowing of wheat leaves (peeli pattiyan), stunted growth, reduced tillering.
metadata.organicTreatment: Apply organic cow compost (gobhar khad) and neem oil spray (3 ml/liter). Ensure proper field drainage to clear stagnant water.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Apply Urea (25kg/acre) for nitrogen deficiency. Spray Propiconazole 25 EC (1 ml per liter of water) for fungal yellow rust.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Avoid over-irrigation, maintain field drainage, use resistant wheat seed varieties (e.g., HD-2967, DBW-187), and apply balanced NPK fertilizers.
metadata.outbreakIndicator: Reported in North Indian wheat growing belts during winter/humid season.

title: Aphids / Mustard-Wheat Aphid (Chepa / Maho / Keede)
description: Small sap-sucking insects causing leaf yellowing, curling, and honeydew mold on crops.

metadata.symptoms: Clusters of tiny green/black aphids on undersides of leaves and stems, leaf yellowing, sticky honeydew emission.
metadata.organicTreatment: Spray Neem oil (3,000 ppm) at 3-5 ml per liter of water with soap solution, or release ladybird beetles.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.5 ml per liter of water or Dimethoate 30 EC at 1.5 ml per liter.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Install yellow sticky traps (10-12 traps per acre), monitor field weekly, preserve natural predators.
